title: [Master]- Create Documents on Recurring Billing ignores the Partner filter and fails when a vendor billing proposal exists
summary: Fixed an issue in recurring billing where the Partner filter was ignored when creating documents, which also prevented document creation when a vendor billing proposal existed.
key_points: Partner filter is now respected during recurring billing document creation
Document creation no longer fails due to existing vendor billing proposals
Bug fix addresses the underlying filter logic in the Create Billing Documents codeunit
Test coverage added for the recurring billing scenario
